title: The ward watches itself
subtitle: Live vitals, NEWS2 ordering, and a chart that explains its own score

steps.caption: Sign in as a doctor. Orb Today lists what needs you first: deteriorating patients, new results, pending signatures.
Patients: the ward ordered by risk. Vitals move because a monitor feed is running; the order is NEWS2-derived, not hand-placed.
Open a chart. The NEWS2 band is computed by Orb's deterministic engine, never by a model.
Why this score? Every parameter's contribution is shown. Orb will not give you a number without showing where it came from.
Patient Story: alerts, notes, doses given, handovers and bundles in one scrollable narrative, with a bookmark for what is new since you last looked.
